nav.intent: Make the builder pipeline dd-native: plans and task files as .dd.json, flow gates driven by document state, typed rels, semantic validate with strict-zero --complete, PR evidence surface — the flow that delivers this plan is the feature itself

nodes.label: Research
instructions: Explore how the relevant code works before you plan — start cheap, climb only when the evidence demands it; never jump straight to a plan.
Run /builder 1a explore "<intent>" — it produces research-dossier.md, a decision packet (not a transcript) with evidence links.
Done when the dossier names the core decision the plan must resolve and the findings that bound it.

comments.text: decision:done evidence: builder-tuning notes.md + structural-proof-graph.md (065) + assets/research-flow-eval-history.md — research artifacts exist and are cited by the plan; time:2026-08-04T08:18Z

nodes.label: Plan
instructions: Write ONE planning document in a single atomic pass — `## Business Specification` (WHAT/WHY) on top, `## Implementation Plan` (HOW: phases, task tables, acceptance criteria, gates G1–G7) below.
Run /builder 1b plan "<intent>" (add --simple for a one-phase flow); it front-loads the clarifying questions, then auto-runs /validate-v2.
Done when <slug>-plan.md carries both halves and reads **Status**: READY — DRAFT means a gate FAILed, so resolve the gaps and re-run.

comments.text: decision:done evidence: plan.dd.json (dd-native, 18 ACs/35 tasks/3 phases, validates 0/0, Opus validation folded, zero open questions) at 987e9e76; time:2026-08-04T08:18Z

nodes.label: P1: dd core — relations, buckets, semantic validator
instructions: Implement exactly ONE phase using the plan's testing approach and domain placement rules — keep the task table and execution.log.md live as you go.
Run /builder 6 implement --plan "<plan path>"; log discoveries, tagging any Deferred/Noteworthy a human must see before ship.
Done when the phase's acceptance criteria are met, the tests pass, and the execution log records what changed plus the proof.
Spend tokens where they can change the outcome; use `--quiet` for routine flow mutations.
Match model tier to work: chores -> cheap subagent, analysis -> Opus-class, judgement -> lead; context may override (§ Shared conventions).
Environment friction is work, not an apology: fix small things, otherwise `harness observe` it — is this environment working for us? (builder SKILL.md invariant #14)

comments.text: verdict:complete reason:13/13 tasks, 29 dw assertions, 9 ACs checked via dd set (commit bf6fec64); coder commits 77e3ef3f..d8ae90f8 + fix ab37d55d; 4064 tests green; dd doctor 0/0. time:2026-08-04T10:19Z

nodes.label: Review: P1
instructions: Review exactly ONE phase's diff against its acceptance criteria — confirm the tests prove behaviour and nothing risky slipped in.
Run /builder 7 review — it inspects the newest assets/reviews/*.md and surfaces a verdict; REQUEST_CHANGES loops back to fix, clean continues to the next phase or post-flight.
Done when the verdict is recorded (one finding line) and either accepted or routed to a fix-loop.

comments.text: verdict:APPROVE reason:cross-model review (pij-widespread-gore, gpt-5.6-terra high) — Dim-0 mutation gate 3 planted-bad classes FIRED (E402/E451/E454); fix round 1 (ab37d55d atomic sibling staging) independently reproduced: failure-path tests fire, sweep confirmed, 4064 tests, warn trio at baseline; fence amendment e2ebb908 accepted. time:2026-08-04T10:19Z

nodes.label: Post-flight
instructions: Close out the flight BEFORE any ship: every phase and review is done; the terminal harness harvest fires at this edge, then the plan folder is archived — this stage runs whether or not the work ever ships.

Run /builder 7b post-flight --plan "<plan path>" — it verifies completion, writes assets/post-flight.md (close-out note + open-items digest), then moves the WHOLE plan folder to docs/plans/archive/<ord>-<slug>/ (git mv, layout intact). Land every flight-plan receipt before the move — the flow file's path changes with the folder.
Done when the close-out note exists and the plan folder lives under docs/plans/archive/ — ship (optional, later) resolves --plan from the archive path.

nodes.label: Ship
instructions: Get the work out — push the branch, open a PR (using the repo's PR guidance), watch its CI checks, and report problems; the merge itself is optional.

Run /builder 8 ship --plan "<plan path>" — the plan folder was archived at post-flight, so resolve --plan under docs/plans/archive/<ord>-<slug>/; push and PR-open each pause for a separate confirm, and any merge waits for a typed PROCEED.
Done when the PR is open and its checks are green (or the failures are reported with a fix-loop offer); a diverged base hands off to 8c reconcile.

nodes.label: Backpressure survey
instructions: Pre-coding seam: survey what the harness can PROVE about the plan's coverage versus what was only eyeballed, then re-plan informed by it.
Run /eng-harness-flow --hook pre-coding --json — a REAL invocation, never narrated; the plan verb does not auto-read the coverage, so fold the findings in yourself.

On done, receipt first, status second: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node backpressure --kind validation --source agent --text "decision:<…> verdict:<…> time:<…> basis_sha256:<full SHA-256 of the plan file>" THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node backpressure --to done. Mandatory unless the human declines — a decline is: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node backpressure --kind decision --source user --text "<their verbatim words>" THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node backpressure --to skipped; never a narrated skip.

Basis is the LATEST plan: on each guided entry recompute the plan file's SHA-256 — a mismatch with (or absence of) the recorded basis_sha256 re-opens this seam via a deterministic new chore, id backpressure-<first 12 hex of that SHA-256> (full hash in its receipt; same bytes re-use this node + receipt, changed bytes create exactly one new node; never resurrect this one — D5).

Router missing, or envelope noop/UNAVAILABLE → same two calls with the detection receipt/envelope as the text: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node backpressure --kind validation --source agent --text "decision:unavailable reason:<…> time:<…>" THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node backpressure --to done — a completed attempt, not a skip.

nodes.label: Boot check
instructions: Pre-flight seam: confirm the harness is healthy before you start coding this phase.
Run /eng-harness-flow --hook pre-flight --json — a REAL invocation; narrate its envelope verbatim, never fabricate one. A manual `harness boot` (or any prior evidence) never satisfies this seam.
Spend tokens where they can change the outcome; use `--quiet` for routine flow mutations.
Match model tier to work: chores -> cheap subagent, analysis -> Opus-class, judgement -> lead; context may override (§ Shared conventions).

On done, receipt first, status second: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node boot-1 --kind validation --source agent --text "verdict:<…> time:<…>" (router missing / envelope noop/UNAVAILABLE → text "decision:unavailable reason:<…> time:<…>" — a completed attempt, not a skip) THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node boot-1 --to done. Mandatory unless the human declines — a decline is: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node boot-1 --kind decision --source user --text "<their verbatim words>" THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node boot-1 --to skipped.

nodes.label: Observe: P1
instructions: Mid-phase capture: record observations (decisions, gotchas, surprises) AS you code, so they don't evaporate as remembered prose.
Run harness observe "<what>" --kind <kind> — a real capture, never a narrated one, repeated through the phase; it stays due the whole time the cursor sits on this phase.
Spend tokens where they can change the outcome; use `--quiet` for routine flow mutations.
Match model tier to work: chores -> cheap subagent, analysis -> Opus-class, judgement -> lead; context may override (§ Shared conventions).

Terminalize at phase end BEFORE the retro drain, receipt first, status second: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node observe-1 --kind validation --source agent --text "captures:<count> pointer:<real capture record> time:<…>" THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node observe-1 --to done — done only after at least one real capture. Human decline instead: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node observe-1 --kind decision --source user --text "<their verbatim words>" THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node observe-1 --to skipped.
Environment friction is work, not an apology: fix small things, otherwise `harness observe` it — is this environment working for us? (builder SKILL.md invariant #14)

nodes.label: Retro: P1 (drain)
instructions: Post-coding seam: drain this phase's observe buffer into durable retro notes before moving on.
Run /eng-harness-flow --hook post-coding --json — a REAL invocation; narrate its envelope verbatim.

Runs after this phase's observe chore is terminalized (real capture receipt, or human decline). On done, receipt first, status second: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node retro-1 --kind validation --source agent --text "verdict:<…> time:<…>" (router missing / envelope noop/UNAVAILABLE → text "decision:unavailable reason:<…> time:<…>" — a completed attempt, not a skip) THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node retro-1 --to done. Mandatory unless the human declines — a decline is: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node retro-1 --kind decision --source user --text "<their verbatim words>" THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node retro-1 --to skipped.

nodes.label: Retro: post-flight (harvest)
instructions: Post-flight seam: the terminal long-horizon harvest — fold this flight's learnings into durable memory at the pre-ship close-out, BEFORE the plan folder archives (so it runs even on work that never ships).
Run /eng-harness-flow --hook post-flight --json — a REAL invocation; narrate its envelope verbatim.

On done, receipt first, status second: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node retro-harvest --kind validation --source agent --text "verdict:<…> time:<…>" (router missing / envelope noop/UNAVAILABLE → text "decision:unavailable reason:<…> time:<…>" — a completed attempt, not a skip) THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node retro-harvest --to done. Mandatory unless the human declines — a decline is: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node retro-harvest --kind decision --source user --text "<their verbatim words>" THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node retro-harvest --to skipped.
